caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle or crib with high, curved sides and ends, rendered primarily in brown tones to simulate the appearance of wood grain. The main object sits on three visible curved legs, and the side facing the viewer displays a decorative panel overlay with a distinct grain pattern. There are two small, heart-shaped cut-outs or decorative elements visible on the side. The headboard of the cradle is ornate, with a curved and scalloped edge, rising higher than the footboard, which is simpler and lower. The main cradle is drawn in a side profile, while the paper also includes two detailed inset diagrams: one in the upper left labeled "HEAD BOARD" showing the headboard’s outline from the front, and another at the bottom left labeled "FOOT AND ROCKER," depicting the foot end and the shape of the rocker rail beneath, accompanied by a dimension marked as "13". The background is plain and off-white, with all objects and lines standing out clearly against it.
title: Cradle
